claims.text: Every bounded-displacement map alpha defines a unitary generalized shift.
An N by N matrix with entries (1/2) exp(2 pi i jk/N) has operator norm N/2.
From ||A|| <= ||A||_HS one may lower-bound ||A|| by a lower bound on ||A||_HS.
sqrt(1-m) supplies a real lower bound for every integer m >= 1.
